case_title: MARIA G. HERNANDEZ et al VS. QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY HERNANDEZ, MARIA G. PASTRANA, HUGO AS TO DEFENDANT QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1 ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-01-2009 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $NONE) SERVED APR-23-2009, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1

PLAINTIFFS ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT, CONEN WONG, IS PRESENT ON BEHALF OF QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1. INTERPRETER, ROBERT WOODS, IS SWORN TO INTERPRET FOR THE PLAINTIFFS. PLAINTIFFS' EXHIBITS RETAINED. ON COURT'S OWN MOTION, THE SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-01-2009 IS CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO MAY-08-2009 AT 4:00 PM IN DEPT. 514. - PLAINTIFFS ARE TO TAKE THE CAR TO AAA FOR A GENERAL DIAGNOSTIC INSPECTION. THE COST IS TO BE DIVIDED EQUALLY BETWEEN THE PARTIES, UP TO $60.00 EACH. JUDGE BRUCE E. CHAN, CLERK: CARLA CONTRERAS, NOT REPORTED (DEPARTMENT 514)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-01-2009 IN DEPARTMENT 506 IS RESET TO MAY-01-2009 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 514 BEFORE HONORABLE BRUCE E. CHAN, CLERK: CARLA CONTRERAS, NOT REPORTED.

PLAINTIFFS ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT, CONEN WONG, IS PRESENT ON BEHALF OF QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1. PLAINTIFFS' WERE UNABLE TO BRING A SPANISH INTERPRETER AND UNABLE TO OBTAIN A DIAGNOSTIC INSPECTION FROM AAA. NO NEW EXHIBITS SUBMITTED TODAY FROM EITHER SIDE. THE SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-08-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-08-2009 BY BRUCE E. CHAN. JUDGE BRUCE E. CHAN, CLERK: CARLA CONTRERAS, NOT REPORTED (DEPARTMENT 514)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-08-2009 - JUDGMENT. (CLERK-BETH WILBER, ROOM 103)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HERNANDEZ, MARIA G. PASTRANA, HUGO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT QUALITY AUTO REPAIR CENTER #1 $115.80 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $165.80 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
